item.title: Professor Layton And The New World Of Steam English Voice Cast Revealed

description.p: And they're real humans!It has been a tense wait to see whether Level-5 would bring in real, human voice actors for the regional dubs of Professor Layton and The New World of Steam, or whether it would slip into the ol' AI that its CEO seems to bring up at every given opportunity. Fortunately, it's positive news.The dev has today revealed the game's English voice cast, and it's headed up by Christopher Robin Miller and Lani Minella — the returning North American Layton and Luke voice actors from the main series. You can even hear a snippet of them in action on the game's website, and yes, the nostalgia is a welcome listen.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Japanese Charts: Zelda: Ocarina Of Time Physical Takes The Lion's Share Of Its Japanese Sales

description.p: Physical is dead, eh?After Nintendo's reveal this week that The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time had shifted 5.2 million units in its first four days, it will come as no surprise to hear that it's a smash hit in Japan. But still, Famitsu's latest numbers are in, and the physical is flying!According to this week's chart, Link's latest produced ~537,000 physical sales in its chart debut — giving it the lion's share of Japan's 810,000 sales that Nintendo reported, and leaving around 273,000 sales for digital. As we say, it's hardly surprising, but still!Read the full article on nintendolife.com
